notes.title: [Steam Next Fest Only]Play Now for a Future Exclusive Skin!
notes.content:
Demo sessions are a great way for developers to get feedback, but after the third mouse bit the dust, we realized that maybe offline demos aren’t the best idea for our game. 
So, if you could kindly share some gameplay videos showing us your reactions while playing, we can tweak the difficulty level for future players, granting them a better (or perhaps even worse) gaming experience.

[h2]Next Fest Commemorative Skin[/h2]
As long as you launch the game during the Next Fest, a small crab accessory will be added to your account in the full version.

[h2]Video Creator Memento[/h2]
You came, you left something behind (no, bad words don’t count), and we’ve got a little something for you too.

Share a video of you playing this game for more than one minute on any social media platform and register [url=https://f.wps.cn/g/t7S6oCax/]here[/url] to receive a Video Creator Skin in the future full version.

[h2]Top Achievement Souvenir[/h2]
Many years from now, you could be sitting by a fireplace (or a space heater), regaling your grandkids with the tale of how you once achieved the impossible during a New Release Festival.

I don't know what drives you to have such determination to do this, but if you complete the demo, you can touch the trophy at the end of the demo and take a photo with the "Demo Emblem" that appears (as shown in the image below). You can post the screenshot on any social media platform and register [url=https://f.wps.cn/g/3er6o0Ef/]here[/url], and we will send you a very special skin in the future full version.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45083002/6df605a643f95010e90794d69e0a3d9a6276d23a.png[/img]

[h2]Don’t Climb Too Hard[/h2]
Sure, the festival skins are limited edition, but they’re just a fun little keepsake. 
Plus, we might *possibly* come up with some other skins later on. 
Don’t hurt yourself chasing after them!

Hope you have a blast playing!


PS:
1.This event is only valid during the 2024 Steam Next Fest. Video submissions will close one week after the festival ends.
2.Taking a photo with the trophy means that the protagonist touches the trophy at the cave entrance in Chapter 1 (not at the end of the tutorial, as there is a trophy there too—please do not confuse them). This unlocks the demo emblem above the trophy, and you must ensure the code in the bottom left corner is fully visible (do not take a photo using the door lock). Register [url=https://kdocs.cn/l/ciNinJcT8vS3]here[/url], and after reviewing and verifying the background data, we will send you a special skin.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45083002/479463efd327d59eea562bc417f0daa6b1be0871.png[/img]

[i]*This article was translated using GPT, and I hope there are no issues with the translation...*[/i]
